title: After a reopen, the first keys a person types reach the focused terminal: (a) Cmd-Q (Keep) and reopen, a real key into the focused terminal as soon as the window shows, 5 cycles; (b) kill of everything and reopen, a line typed ~2 s after the terminals settle
why: REOPEN-F4 (STATUS 4618, 4653): on feat 0d19fe6 the first key typed at the reopened window's first frame was lost in 10 of 15 cycles (focus resolved none); REOPEN-F5 (same cause, STATUS 4658): after a kill of everything the line typed after the reopen never reached the new shell in 2 of 3. Owner of the fix: reopen-f4.

steps.title: real keys need a key window
set-up: Home finishes its first load
(a) Cmd-Q (Keep) and reopen, a real key into each visible terminal (the focused one first, as the window shows), 5 cycles, no film
(a) every marker key after each reopen reached its terminal exactly once
(b) SIGKILL of everything of the bundle at once, reopen
(b) a person waits ~2 s after the terminals show
(b) a person types a line with real keys ~2 s after the terminals show (no creation-hold wait)
(b) the line typed after the kill-all reopen reached the new shell
